title: Etale algebras lift across an arbitrary quotient
statement:
The algebra of [def-exc-etale-algebra-lift] is etale of finite presentation
over $A$, and its specified reduction
$B^{\mathrm{lift}}/IB^{\mathrm{lift}}\to\overline B$ is an isomorphism.
Hence every etale finite-presentation $A/I$-algebra has such a lift, with no
nilpotence assumption on $I$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-etale-algebra-lift-etale-fp] and [lem-exc-etale-algebra-lift-reduction] to the specified P and L, and combine their conclusions.

For an etale A/I-algebra, obtain a finite square Jacobian presentation from [lem-exc-etale-jacobian-presentation]. Reindex both relations and variables by Fin (Nat.card iota) using the same equivalence. The reindexed map is the identity. Surjectivity of the quotient map induces surjectivity on multivariate polynomials, so choose a preimage of each relation and form the genuine CoefficientLift data of [def-exc-etale-algebra-lift]. Apply the preceding conjunction theorem to this lift.

lean.statement: theorem SquareJacobianPresentation.CoefficientLift.etale_and_reduction_equiv {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra (A ⧸ I) B] {m : ℕ} (P : Algebra.SquareJacobianPresentation (A ⧸ I) B (Fin m)) (L : Algebra.SquareJacobianPresentation.CoefficientLift I P) : Algebra.Etale A L.LiftRing ∧ Algebra.FinitePresentation A L.LiftRing ∧ ∃ e : (L.LiftRing ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A L.LiftRing)) ≃+* B, ∀ x : L.LiftRing, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A L.LiftRing)) x) = L.reduction x
lean.note: The first theorem treats every chosen coefficient lift and identifies the specified reduction map; the second states existence for every etale quotient algebra. Algebra.Etale includes finite presentation.
